name: flota
description: Live pane listing your Claude Code sessions (local and Remote Control) and the claude-rc instances on your servers, with restart, start and URL buttons

hosts.title: Servers
hosts.description: Comma-separated SSH hosts that run claude-rc (for example: vps1,vps2). Leave empty to list sessions only.

sshCommand.title: SSH command
sshCommand.description: Command used to reach the servers. On Windows with keys in WSL use: wsl ssh

devices.title: Health devices
devices.description: Comma-separated devices for the health screen: 'laptop' (this machine) and SSH hosts, for example laptop,vps1,phone. Phones with Termux work too.

typesafeKeyFile.title: TypeSafe key file
typesafeKeyFile.description: Path to a file holding your TypeSafe API key (for example ~/.secrets/typesafe.key). With it, Jev reads each session's last message and flags the ones waiting for you. Empty turns it off.
